body: Done: both are supported. Browsers use the __Host-auth_session cookie; mobile and native clients ask for a bearer token with the Auth-Token-Mode: bearer header and read Set-Auth-Token (authhttp), with the handoff plugin (round 2) moving a signed-in user to a native app and desktop sign-in through the system browser (round 3). Guides: docs/integrations/mobile-apps.md, spa-frontends.md, desktop-apps.md. Verified by r10-lore audit 2026-10-05.
